verdict.rationale: Codegen's CLI lets developers view agents and run them with 'full telemetry and monitoring,' and agents can 'report progress' via Slack, giving some real-time visibility into agent activity and status. However, there's no explicit documentation of a live dashboard/status stream showing step-by-step actions as they happen, and the closest 'trace' feature is framed as post-hoc analysis/debugging rather than live watching. Missing for 10: a documented real-time UI/dashboard showing live agent status, explicit streaming of in-progress actions, and independent/hands-on confirmation of live monitoring accuracy.
